player_prompt.intro:
Aweyi'yɛ Mɛlɛ {player_id} le puɖe puɖe Tic Tac Toe. Aweyi'yɛ hɛɖɛ'yɛ '{symbol}'.
Kɩɖɛ'yɛ se aɖɔɔ kɛtɛɛ kɛtɛɛ (wɩsɩ, kɩŋ, ɛntɛɛ).
Aweyi ɛɖɔɔ kɛtɛɛ kɛtɛɛ kɔyɔ, aɖɩɩ.
Sɔsɔ aweyi'yɛ tɔm se '[4]' nɛ aɖɔ aweyi'yɛ hɛɖɛ'yɛ cell 4.
Aweyi {player_id} kɛ aweyi'yɛ '{symbol}' nɛ aweyi'yɛ ɛjaɖɛ'yɛ '{opponent_symbol}'.

outcome.loss: Aleɣya laɖʋ {player_id} lesi alɩwaatʋ ndʋ ɛtɛzɩɣ tɔm yɔɔdʋʋ yɔ!
